content.title: Guideline updates - Heart failure
content.summary: Updates to heart failure terminology, classification, treatment algorithms, comorbidity management, cardiomyopathy guidance including genetic testing, and quality indicators.
changes: Change of the term 'heart failure with mid-range ejection fraction' to 'heart failure with mildly reduced ejection fraction (HFmrEF).
A new simplified treatment algorithm for HFrEF.
Addition of a treatment algorithm for HFrEF according to phenotypes.
Updated treatments for non-cardiovascular comorbidities including diabetes, hyperkalaemia, iron deficiency, and cancer.
Updates on cardiomyopathies including the role of genetic testing and new treatments.

abbreviations.HFmrEF: heart failure with mildly reduced ejection fraction
abbreviations.HFrEF: heart failure with reduced ejection fraction

notes: Document highlights role of genetic testing in cardiomyopathies but does not list specific genes on this page.
